metrics.source: same cAdvisor container CPU series used by both pipelines

scenario_b: native trace_id/span_id log correlation when active

shared_measurement_rule: Compute semantic duration and outcome once at the application observation point. Pass the same observation object to enabled adapters; each adapter retains its own identifiers and native representation.
raw_policy: Preserve native adapter output in RAW. Only the Common RCA View applies the semantic contract and removes explicitly audit-only instrumentation noise.

auto_instrumentation_classes.REQUIRED_BY_SHARED_CONTRACT: An automatic instrument is the chosen implementation of a shared observation boundary.
auto_instrumentation_classes.CORRELATION_ONLY: Maintains native context propagation or IDs without creating a second model-visible logical operation.
auto_instrumentation_classes.RAW_AUDIT_ONLY: Retained in RAW but excluded from common diagnostic evidence.
auto_instrumentation_classes.UNNECESSARY: Disabled when it duplicates a manually shared observation or exports unrelated runtime diagnostics.
